example_sentences_in_bangla: এই এণ্ডাবাচ্চাদের নিয়ে সাবধানে থাকতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The village little children are all playing in the field.
We have to be careful with these small kids.
note: This idiom is often used in rural or semi-urban Bengali speech to refer to young children endearingly, possibly deriving from the image of newly hatched chicks.
